description: Discrete simulated trip progress for the offline route sketch. Every value is authored here: the UI reads one checkpoint per rendered UISpec and never accumulates, animates, or times its own advance. 0 is the start of the sketch polyline, 1 the end. These are staged demo values, not measured positions.
matching: Checkpoints are listed in trip order and matched against task state; the last matching entry wins, so a later, more specific stage overrides an earlier one. A task state that matches nothing has no progress at all, which the renderer shows as a route with no vehicle marker.

checkpoints.note: Navigation just started; the marker sits near the origin.
Charging accepted while under way. Staged position only: it is not claimed to coincide with the charging stop on the supercharger route variant.
Flight on the ground while still driving.
Parked at the pickup point: end of the outbound sketch.
Return route selected; the sketch is now the home route, so progress restarts near its origin.
Rear cabin preferences applied on the way home.
Home: end of the return sketch.
